dataIdInfo.idAbs: OWRB - Lakes of Oklahoma This dataset represents lakes and ponds in Oklahoma. The dataset originated from the Oklahoma Conservation Commission. It is believed that the water bodies were digitized from the USGS 1:100,000 topographic maps. Attributes were added by the Oklahoma Water Resources Board.
dataIdInfo.idPurp: The purpose of this dataset is to represent the lakes and ponds of Oklahoma.

prcStep.stepDesc: Attribute fields were added to the original dataset. These fields contain information regarding the Oklahoma Water Quality Standards. Major lakes that were built after the USGS 1:100,000 were published were added to this shapefile. The 1995 digital ortho photos were used to digitize these lakes. They included: R.C. Longmire Lake, Wes Watkins Reservoir, and Bell Cow Lake.
